title: Cookbook
description: Write a cookbook. Make doughs, sauces, fillings, pastries and cakes.

title: History of ideas
description: Work through the history of ideas. You're the philosopher now.

title: Mars: A Light That Answers
description: A damaged landing strands a small expedition. Recovery becomes a rescue, then a return journey carrying people and evidence. This is an engineering story with recovered qualified systems, not real survival instructions.

title: Settlement: A River Worth Returning To
description: Starting from four storybook elements, travel from an orchard to a coastal gathering in rustic coloured woodcuts. Make useful things for people you meet. The world remembers what you leave behind.

title: Theology: Disputed Questions
description: A manuscript desk, not a test of faith. Follow a wound, a failed promise, bread, a hungry household and a request for prayer through changing arguments. Build what each writer is claiming, test it against a case, and leave real disagreements open. New chapters reuse distinctions you have made. Each item has a short explanation you can revisit.
